Employee Document Type: Colombia ~ Employee Document Type ~ Tipo de documento de identificación del trabajador ~ Coded identity-document type of the employee. Colombia issues NO separate social-security number: the document type plus the document number IS the composite key across the electronic payroll XML, the integrated contribution return (PILA), Formulario 220 and Formato 2276. The code system differs by artefact - DIAN filings use the numeric catalogue (13 = cédula de ciudadanía) while PILA and the severance-savings deposit file use the two-letter catalogue (CC). One master value; the engine emits the artefact's own code. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) DIAN numeric catalogue; emitted as A(2) alpha on PILA and cesantías ~ Employee Document Type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Document_Type - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE044, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-003, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 24, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-005 (numeral N02, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T03, Mandatory=Y). The nomina electronica code list is Anexo Tecnico table 5.2.1. Scope option_mapper_scope.personal_id_type. Validates the length of the document NUMBER - a PEP must be exactly 15 digits (SOI hard rule). CO-GAP-06: no code exists for the PPT (Permiso por Protección Temporal, Decreto 216 de 2021); code 47 (PEP) is the only available proxy.
Employee Document Number: Colombia ~ Employee Document Number ~ Número de identificación del trabajador ~ Identity-document number of the employee, without dots, hyphens, spaces or a verification digit. Primary per-employee key on every Colombian statutory filing and the social-security identifier. ~ M ~ Text ~ Numeric, no separators (cédula 8-10 digits; PEP exactly 15). Alphanumeric only for passport (41), foreign identity document (42) and foreign tax number (50) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Document_Number - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE045, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-004, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 25, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T04, Mandatory=Y). Field widths differ by artefact: A(16) space-filled on PILA, N(16) zero-filled on the cesantias deposit file. CO-GAP-07 (SCHEMA TRAP): NIE045 is typed xsd:integer in the nómina electrónica XSD, so an alphanumeric passport number cannot be schema-valid. No official workaround published - carry as an open item.
Employee Bank Name: Colombia ~ Employee Bank Name ~ Banco ~ Name of the bank holding the employee's salary account. Reported on the electronic payroll support document whenever the payment medium is bank-mediated. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium (42, 45, 47, 48, 49). Must be absent or empty where Payment Method = 10 (efectivo). ~ Text ~ Free text ~ Spec ref: Employee.Bank_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE066, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Payment Method, Bank Account Type and Bank Account Number.
Employee Bank Account Type: Colombia ~ Employee Bank Account Type ~ Tipo de cuenta ~ Type of the employee's salary bank account - savings or current. Colombia has only these two. ~ CM ~ Mandatory together with Employee Bank Name and Employee Bank Account Number where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium. ~ Text ~ AHORROS / CORRIENTE ~ Bank Account Type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Bank_Account_Type - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE067, Mandatory=C).
Employee Bank Account Number: Colombia ~ Employee Bank Account Number ~ Número de cuenta ~ Employee salary account number. COLOMBIA DOES NOT USE IBAN. Domestic account numbers are numeric, of bank-specific length (commonly 10-17 digits), with no national check-digit standard. ~ CM ~ Mandatory together with Employee Bank Name and Employee Bank Account Type where Payment Method is a bank-mediated medium. ~ Text ~ Numeric, bank-specific length (commonly 10-17 digits). NOT an IBAN. ~ Spec ref: Employee.Bank_Account_Number - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE068, Mandatory=C). CCG Module 2.2 confirms no IBAN and no national check digit - do not apply an IBAN validator.
Employee Internal Code: Colombia ~ Employee Internal Code ~ Código del trabajador ~ Employer's own internal employee number. Optional on the electronic payroll support document; used by the employer to reconcile the document to its own personnel records. ~ O ~ Text ~ Free text (employer-defined) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Internal_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE009 and NIE063, Mandatory=N). Not the document number and not a substitute for it.
Severance-Savings Fund Account Number: Colombia ~ Severance-Savings Fund Account Number ~ Número de cuenta del fondo de cesantías ~ Account number held by the employee at the chosen severance-savings fund, used on the annual severance deposit file. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the fund requires an account number on the deposit file; otherwise the employee is identified by document type plus document number validated against the Asofondos affiliate base. ~ Text ~ Fund-specific numeric/alphanumeric ~ Declared in build_co_specs._DD_MASTER_MAPPINGS as Employee.Cesantias_Fund_Account but not carried as a positional field in the published Simple S.A. / SOI layout, which keys the record on document type + number. DERIVED - confirm per-fund requirement with RA.
Employer NIT: Colombia ~ Employer NIT ~ NIT del empleador ~ Tax identification number assigned by DIAN on registration in the Single Tax Registry (RUT). Primary employer key on every Colombian statutory artefact. Stored and transmitted WITHOUT dots, hyphens or the verification digit. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(9) to N(10) - no dots, no hyphens, no verification digit ~ Spec ref: Company.NIT - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE033, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 5, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 5, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-005 (numeral ENV-01, Mandatory=Y). Validation rules NIE038 and NIE041 require the number 'sin guiones ni DV' in one attribute and the verification digit in another - an engine that concatenates them FAILS schema validation. The last digit(s) of the NIT also fix the filing deadline for Formulario 350, PILA and the información exógena.
Employer NIT Verification Digit (DV): Colombia ~ Employer NIT Verification Digit (DV) ~ Dígito de verificación (DV) del NIT ~ Single-digit verification digit of the employer NIT, computed by DIAN using a weighted modulus-11 algorithm. ALWAYS A SEPARATE FIELD from the NIT itself. ~ M ~ On the contribution return the value is mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); for every other case the field must be ZERO. ~ Text ~ N(1), 0 to 9 ~ Spec ref: Company.NIT_DV - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE034, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 6, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (A1-004 and T2R1-007, Mandatory=C/Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 6, Mandatory=Y). Verified algorithm (CCG Module 2.1): weights [3,7,13,17,19,23,29,37,41,43,47,53,59,67,71] applied right to left, S = sum(digit_i x W_i), R = S mod 11, DV = R if R < 2 else 11 - R. Verified against NIT 902025831 -> DV 4 and NIT 800197268 -> DV 4. Stored, not recomputed at runtime, but validated on entry.
Employer Document Type: Colombia ~ Employer Document Type ~ Tipo de documento del aportante ~ Identity-document type of the employer on the integrated contribution return. A corporate employer is NI (número de identificación tributaria); a natural-person employer uses a personal document type. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(2) - PILA employer document-type catalogue ~ Employer Document Type ~ Spec ref: Company.Document_Type - CO-PILA-003 (A1-002 and T2R1-005, Mandatory=Y) and CO-CESANTIAS-006 (E01, Mandatory=Y), the latter as the composite Company.Document_Type + Company.Document_Number ('Tipo y número de documento del aportante') on CO-CESANTIAS-006. Where Employer Person Type = N (natural) the type NI is NOT available. Company.Document_Number (CO-PILA-003 A1-003 and T2R1-006, A(16)) is NOT a separate master-data field: for a legal person it is the Employer NIT and for a natural person it is the personal document number - hold the value once and emit it into whichever field the artefact requires.
Employer Commercial Registration Number: Colombia ~ Employer Commercial Registration Number ~ Número de matrícula mercantil ~ Commercial registration number issued by the Chamber of Commerce of the municipality of domicile. ~ CM ~ Mandatory for commercial entities and for any employer claiming the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation benefits or the Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 34 part-time contribution regime. ~ Text ~ Alphanumeric - format set by each Chamber of Commerce ~ CCG Module 2.1. One of only three sub-national registration elements in Colombian payroll (the others being the family compensation fund and the work-centre risk class). DERIVED format - the Chambers do not publish a common mask; confirm with RA.
DIAN Electronic Payroll Software Identif: Colombia ~ DIAN Electronic Payroll Software Identifier ~ Identificador del software (SoftwareID) ~ Identifier assigned by DIAN when the employer's payroll software is activated for the electronic payroll support document. Together with a secret PIN it produces the CUNE security code carried in every document. ~ M ~ Text ~ String assigned by DIAN at software activation ~ CCG Module 2.1; Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 arts. 1, 5, 22. THE PAIRED PIN IS A CREDENTIAL: it never appears in the XML and is held in the integration credential store described in CO-SIR-001, NOT in this Data Dictionary. The security code itself (SHA-384 of SoftwareID + PIN + document number) is a COMPUTED value (SYS), not master data.
Electronic Payroll Document Prefix: Colombia ~ Electronic Payroll Document Prefix ~ Prefijo de numeración de la nómina electrónica ~ Employer-defined prefix of the electronic payroll document number. The document number is the prefix plus a consecutive sequence and must be unique per employee. ~ M ~ Text ~ Employer-defined alphanumeric prefix ~ CCG Module 2.1. The CONSECUTIVE NUMBER is generated by the engine (SYS), not master data. DIAN global validation rule 90 rejects a repeated document number for the same employee; a rejected document must be re-transmitted with a NEW consecutive number.
Information Operator Code: Colombia ~ Information Operator Code ~ Código del operador de información ~ Code of the licensed private information operator through which the integrated contribution return is filed and paid. The employer NEVER transacts directly with the government for social security. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) - assigned by the operador's own system ~ Spec ref: CO-PILA-003 Field Options ('Código del operador de información', 2 digits). CCG Module 2.1 item 9 - an employer-level election stored once and inherited by every employee. Operadores are private entities licensed by the Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social.
Legal Representative Document Type: Colombia ~ Legal Representative Document Type ~ Tipo de identificación del representante legal ~ Identity-document type of the employer's legal representative, who signs the contribution return and the withholding-tax return. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); optional where Employer Person Type = N (natural). Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type. ~ Text ~ A(2) - narrower catalogue than the contributor list ~ Legal Representative Document Type ~ Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID_Type - CO-PILA-003 (A1-020, Mandatory=C). NI, TI, SC, PE and RC are NOT available for a legal representative even though several of them are available for a contributor.
Legal Representative Identification Numb: Colombia ~ Legal Representative Identification Number ~ Número de identificación del representante legal / signatario ~ Identity-document number of the legal representative or signatory of the return. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where Employer Person Type = J (jurídica); optional where Employer Person Type = N. Bidirectional pair with Employer Person Type and with the legal-representative name block. ~ Text ~ A(16) on PILA, left-justified and space-filled; numeric on Formulario 350 ~ Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID - CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 139, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (A1-018, Mandatory=C).
Legal Representative Verification Digit: Colombia ~ Legal Representative Verification Digit ~ DV del signatario ~ Verification digit of the legal representative's or signatory's identification number. ~ CM ~ Populated wherever the signatory identification number is populated. ~ Text ~ N(1), 0 to 9 ~ Spec ref: Company.Legal_Rep_ID_DV - CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 140, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (A1-019, Mandatory=Y). Same weighted modulus-11 algorithm as the employer NIT DV.
Employee First Surname: Colombia ~ Employee First Surname ~ Primer apellido ~ First (paternal) surname of the employee as registered with the civil authorities. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts ~ Spec ref: Employee.First_Surname - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE046, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-011, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 26, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-005 (numeral N03, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T05, Mandatory=Y). Validated as a SET with the other three name parts against the Asofondos affiliate base on the cesantías deposit.
Employee Second Surname: Colombia ~ Employee Second Surname ~ Segundo apellido ~ Second (maternal) surname of the employee. ~ CM ~ The nómina electrónica schema declares this a REQUIRED attribute even though many Colombians and virtually all foreign nationals have only one surname. Where the person has no second surname a placeholder must be emitted or schema validation fails. Space-filled on the PILA and cesantías fixed-width layouts. ~ Text ~ A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts ~ Spec ref: Employee.Second_Surname - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE047, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-012, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 27, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T06, Mandatory=Y). SCHEMA TRAP recorded in CCG Module 2.2: no official guidance exists on the placeholder value. Carry as an open item and agree the placeholder with RA before go-live.
Employee First Name: Colombia ~ Employee First Name ~ Primer nombre ~ First given name of the employee. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(20) on PILA and cesantías; variable length on the DIAN artefacts ~ Spec ref: Employee.First_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE048, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-013, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 28, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T07, Mandatory=Y).
Employee Other Names: Colombia ~ Employee Other Names ~ Otros nombres ~ Second and any further given names of the employee. ~ CM ~ Conditional on the person having a second or further given name; space-filled on the fixed-width layouts when absent. ~ Text ~ A(20) on PILA and cesantías; A(30) on the PILA employer block; variable on DIAN ~ Spec ref: Employee.Other_Names - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE049, Mandatory=N), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-014, Mandatory=N), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 29, Mandatory=N), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T08, Mandatory=C). PILA calls the field 'Segundo nombre'; the nómina electrónica calls it 'OtrosNombres' and accepts more than one given name in the single attribute.
Date of Birth: Colombia ~ Date of Birth ~ Fecha de nacimiento ~ Employee date of birth. Not reported on any of the six in-scope statutory filings, but held as onboarding master data because it drives the identity-document path: a worker aged 15-17 holds a tarjeta de identidad (code 12) which converts to a cédula de ciudadanía (code 13) on majority - a change of the document-type + number composite key that must be actioned. ~ O ~ Date ~ AAAA-MM-DD ~ Not filing-mandated on the in-scope returns. CCG Module 2.2 records the minor-to-adult document-type change. Retirement age (57 women / 62 men, public defined-benefit regime) affects entitlement, not the payroll rate - see CCG Module 5.
Gender: Colombia ~ Gender ~ Sexo ~ Employee gender. Standard onboarding demographic; Colombia does not vary any payroll rate, threshold or contribution by gender. ~ O ~ Text ~ M / F ~ Gender ~ Not reported on any of the six in-scope statutory filings and not a calculation driver. Held for HR master data and affiliation paperwork only.
Nationality: Colombia ~ Nationality ~ Nacionalidad ~ Employee nationality. Drives the identity-document path (Colombian national -> cédula de ciudadanía 13; resident foreign national -> cédula de extranjería 22; non-resident -> passport 41) and, together with proof of affiliation to a foreign pension system, the foreign-national pension-waiver flag. ~ M ~ Text ~ ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. CO) ~ ISO 3166-1 (see the 'Country Codes - ISO 3166-1' sheet) ~ Calculation-driving classifier. NOT the same question as Tax Residence Status: a Colombian national can be a non-resident and a foreign national can be a resident. Keep the two fields independent - see CCG Module 2.2 and the resident/non-resident matrix at Module 6.2.
Employee Residential Address: Colombia ~ Employee Residential Address ~ Dirección de residencia del trabajador ~ Residential address of the employee, as reported on the annual severance-savings deposit file. ~ CM ~ Mandatory on the annual severance-savings deposit record. Must be consistent with the residence department and municipality codes, which are the DANE halves of the same address. ~ Text ~ CHAR(50) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Address - CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T15, Mandatory=C). DISTINCT from Place of Work Address - the nómina electrónica reports where the employee WORKS, this reports where the employee LIVES. Do not map one to the other.
Residence Department Code: Colombia ~ Residence Department Code ~ Código del departamento de residencia ~ Two-digit DANE DIVIPOLA department code of the employee's residential address. ~ CM ~ Mandatory wherever the residential address is reported. Must be the department half of the same five-digit DIVIPOLA code whose municipality half is the residence municipality code. ~ Text ~ N(2) DANE DIVIPOLA ~ Spec ref: Employee.Department_Code - CO-DIAN-005 (numeral N04, Mandatory=Y), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T16, Mandatory=C). Use the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, NOT the ISO 3166-2:CO list on the reference sheets.
Residence Municipality Code: Colombia ~ Residence Municipality Code ~ Código del municipio de residencia ~ Three-digit DANE DIVIPOLA municipality suffix of the employee's residential address. ~ CM ~ Mandatory wherever the residential address is reported. Must be the municipality half of the same five-digit DIVIPOLA code whose department half is the residence department code. ~ Text ~ N(3) DANE DIVIPOLA suffix (e.g. 001 for Bogotá D.C. within department 11) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Municipality_Code - CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T17, Mandatory=C). SPLIT-CODE TRAP: PILA, Formulario 220 and the cesantías file carry the department and municipality in SEPARATE 2 + 3 fields, whereas the nómina electrónica carries ONE five-digit code (11001). Store the five digits once and split on output.
Employee E-mail Address: Colombia ~ Employee E-mail Address ~ Correo electrónico del trabajador ~ Employee e-mail address, reported on the annual severance-savings deposit file and used for payslip and certificate delivery. ~ CM ~ Conditional on an e-mail address being held for the employee. ~ Text ~ CHAR(50) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Email - CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T19, Mandatory=C).
Employee Landline Telephone: Colombia ~ Employee Landline Telephone ~ Teléfono fijo del trabajador ~ Seven-digit landline telephone number of the employee, as required by the severance-savings deposit layout. ~ CM ~ Conditional on a 7-digit landline being held; the layout is filled with spaces or zeros where only a mobile number exists. ~ Text ~ N(7) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Phone - CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T18, Mandatory=C). The layout has no mobile-number field - a mobile number cannot be substituted.
Colombian Abroad Flag: Colombia ~ Colombian Abroad Flag ~ Colombiano en el exterior ~ Indicates that the employee is a Colombian national performing the work outside Colombia. Where set, the work-location department and municipality must be left BLANK on the contribution return. ~ CM ~ Usable ONLY where Employee Document Type is cédula de ciudadanía (13 / CC) or tarjeta de identidad (12 / TI). Where set, Place of Work Department Code and Place of Work Municipality Code must be blank. ~ Text ~ S / N (emitted as blank or X on the PILA fixed-width file) ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ Spec ref: Employee.Colombian_Abroad_Flag - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-008, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Employee Document Type and the two work-location codes.
Place of Work Country Code: Colombia ~ Place of Work Country Code ~ País del lugar de trabajo ~ Country in which the employee performs the work. A required attribute of the worker element on the electronic payroll support document. ~ M ~ Text ~ ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (Anexo Técnico table 5.4.1) ~ ISO 3166-1 (see the 'Country Codes - ISO 3166-1' sheet) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Work_Country_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE050, Mandatory=Y). For a transnational teleworker a Colombian contract remains governed by Colombian law and the ARL must guarantee cover in the country of performance - Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 54, CCG Module 11.
Place of Work Department Code: Colombia ~ Place of Work Department Code ~ Departamento del lugar de trabajo ~ Two-digit DANE DIVIPOLA department code of the place where the employee performs the work. ~ CM ~ Mandatory on the nómina electrónica. Left BLANK on the contribution return where the Colombian Abroad Flag is set, and where Worker Type = 40 (beneficiario UPC adicional). ~ Text ~ N(2) DANE DIVIPOLA (Anexo Técnico table 5.4.2) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Work_Department_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE051, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-009, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with the Colombian Abroad Flag and Worker Type.
Place of Work Municipality Code: Colombia ~ Place of Work Municipality Code ~ Municipio del lugar de trabajo ~ DANE DIVIPOLA municipality of the place where the employee performs the work. ~ CM ~ Mandatory on the nómina electrónica. Left BLANK on the contribution return in the same two cases as the work-location department code - Colombian Abroad Flag set, or Worker Type = 40. ~ Text ~ N(5) full DIVIPOLA on the nómina electrónica (11001); N(3) municipality suffix on PILA ~ Spec ref: Employee.Work_Municipality_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE052, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-010, Mandatory=C). SPLIT-CODE TRAP - see Residence Municipality Code. Store five digits once and split on output.
Place of Work Address: Colombia ~ Place of Work Address ~ Dirección del lugar de trabajo ~ Street address of the place where the employee performs the work. A required attribute of the worker element on the electronic payroll support document. ~ M ~ Text ~ Free text ~ Spec ref: Employee.Work_Address - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE053, Mandatory=Y). DISTINCT from the employee's residential address.
Work Centre Code: Colombia ~ Work Centre Code ~ Centro de trabajo ~ Employer-assigned code of the work centre to which the employee is attached. The occupational-risk CLASS attaches to the WORK CENTRE, not to the company, so this field selects the risk class - and therefore the occupational-risk rate - that applies to the employee. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the employer operates more than one work centre, and mandatory where the VCT change-of-work-centre event is reported for the period. ~ Text ~ N(9) zero-filled to the left ~ Spec ref: Employee.Work_Centre_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-062, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with the VCT novedad and with the work centre's Occupational Risk Class. Legal basis: Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.5.6 - a company with a corporate office and a plant legitimately carries two different risk classes. The RATE itself is a parameter (WTC), not DD.
Hire Date: Colombia ~ Hire Date ~ Fecha de ingreso del trabajador ~ Date on which the employment relationship with the declaring employer commenced. ~ M ~ Date ~ AAAA-MM-DD ~ Spec ref: Contract.Start_Date - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE002, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-080, Mandatory=C), CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T20, Mandatory=Y). On PILA the field is mandatory where the ING novedad is marked. Seniority driver for the severance-savings liquidation, the indemnity tier and work-clothing eligibility. Colombia has NO cumulative-withholding carry-over between employers and no P45 equivalent - a new employer starts the withholding calculation fresh (CCG Module 2.2).
Termination Date: Colombia ~ Termination Date ~ Fecha de retiro del trabajador ~ Date on which the employment relationship ended. ~ CM ~ Mandatory upon a leaver event: populated on the nómina electrónica only for the month in which the relationship ends, and mandatory on the contribution return where the RET (retiro) novedad is marked. ~ Date ~ AAAA-MM-DD ~ Spec ref: Contract.End_Date - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE003, Mandatory=C), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-081, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional pair with the RET novedad. Must fall inside or before the settlement window of the document.
Contract Type: Colombia ~ Contract Type ~ Tipo de contrato ~ Type of employment contract. Five values in the private-sector population: fixed-term (maximum four years after Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6), indefinite-term, specific work or task, apprenticeship and internship. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(1) - code 1 to 5 (Anexo Técnico table 5.5.2) ~ Contract Type ~ Spec ref: Contract.Type_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE061, Mandatory=Y). Scope option_mapper_scope.contract_type. Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21 recast the apprenticeship as a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decreto 0223 of 5 March 2026 - it is now a contract type, not a training arrangement.
Worker Type: Colombia ~ Worker Type ~ Tipo de trabajador / tipo de cotizante ~ Contributor category of the employee. Selects the contribution rules that apply on the integrated contribution return and on the electronic payroll support document. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) zero-filled - e.g. 01 (Anexo Técnico table 5.5.3 / PILA tipo cotizante) ~ Worker Type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Worker_Type_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE041, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-005, Mandatory=Y). MAPPING TRAP: the nómina electrónica table 5.5.3 carries only SIXTEEN values while the PILA tipo cotizante list carries far more - copying a PILA code straight into the XML is a documented failure. Public-sector codes 18, 30, 47 and 58, domestic service 02, community mothers 04, associated-work cooperative members 31 and every independent-worker code are OUT OF SCOPE - see the mapper Notes.
Worker Sub-Type: Colombia ~ Worker Sub-Type ~ Subtipo de trabajador / subtipo de cotizante ~ Contributor sub-category. The value that matters for corporate payroll is 01 - an employed old-age pensioner in active service, who makes NO pension contribution. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) zero-filled - 00 where no sub-type applies ~ Worker Sub-Type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Worker_SubType_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE042, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-006, Mandatory=Y). HARD RULE: where the sub-type is 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 09 or 12 the PILA pension-contribution rate field MUST be 0. This field carries the 'active pensioner' attribute - do NOT create a separate active-pensioner flag. MAPPING TRAP: the nómina electrónica table 5.5.4 carries only 00 and 01; PILA carries more.
Pay Frequency: Colombia ~ Pay Frequency ~ Periodo de nómina ~ Frequency at which salary is paid. Labour Code art. 134 caps the interval at one month for monthly salaries and one week for day wages; any shorter frequency is permitted. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(1) - code 1 to 6 (Anexo Técnico table 5.5.1) ~ Pay Frequency ~ Spec ref: Contract.Pay_Frequency_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE029, Mandatory=Y). CRITICAL CONFIGURATION POINT: whatever the frequency, the electronic payroll support document is ONE MONTHLY document per employee - Res. DIAN 000013 de 2021 art. 3, 'con independencia de que el obligado realice pagos en periodos diferentes o inferiores'. A semi-monthly payroll does NOT produce two filings a month.
Payment Form: Colombia ~ Payment Form ~ Forma de pago ~ Settlement form of the payroll payment. The Anexo Técnico publishes a single value - contado (immediate settlement). ~ M ~ Text ~ N(1) - code 1 (Anexo Técnico table 5.3.3.1) ~ Payment Form ~ Spec ref: Contract.Payment_Form_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE064, Mandatory=Y). Distinct from Payment Method - 'forma' is cash-vs-credit settlement, 'método' is the medium.
Payment Method: Colombia ~ Payment Method ~ Medio de pago ~ Medium through which the net salary is paid. Drives whether the bank block (bank name, account type, account number) must be populated. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) - UN/EDIFACT 4461 code (Anexo Técnico table 5.3.3.2) ~ Payment Method ~ Spec ref: Contract.Payment_Method_Code - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE065, Mandatory=Y). Bidirectional set with the three bank fields: where the value is 10 (efectivo) the bank attributes must be ABSENT; where it is a bank-mediated medium they are all required.
Weekly Contracted Hours: Colombia ~ Weekly Contracted Hours ~ Jornada semanal contratada ~ Contracted ordinary weekly working hours. The statutory maximum steps DOWN during fiscal year 2026: 44 hours to 14 July 2026 and 42 hours from 15 July 2026. ~ M ~ Decimal ~ Hours per week, up to 2 decimals (e.g. 42.00) ~ CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Calculation-driving: the ordinary hourly rate, and therefore every overtime and night-surcharge value, is derived from it. NOT on any in-scope statutory filing - held as a calculation input. The 42-hour step is a PARAMETER (WTC); this field is the employee's contracted value.
Days Worked Per Week: Colombia ~ Days Worked Per Week ~ Días laborados por semana ~ Number of ordinary working days in the employee's week - five or six. ~ M ~ Integer ~ 5 or 6 ~ CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Together with the obligatory rest day it determines which days attract the Sunday / public-holiday surcharge. Not on any in-scope statutory filing.
Obligatory Rest Day: Colombia ~ Obligatory Rest Day ~ Día de descanso obligatorio ~ Weekday designated as the employee's obligatory paid rest day. SUNDAY IS PRESUMED unless a written agreement designates another day. ~ M ~ Text ~ Weekday name (default: Domingo) ~ CCG Module 2.2. Calculation-driving: the Sunday / public-holiday surcharge attaches to the designated rest day, not automatically to the calendar Sunday. Default value: Domingo.
36-Hour Shift System Flag: Colombia ~ 36-Hour Shift System Flag ~ Jornada por turnos sucesivos de 36 horas ~ Indicates that the employee works the successive-shift regime, which has its own weekly-hours and surcharge treatment. ~ O ~ Text ~ S / N ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ CCG Module 2.2 working-time group. Calculation-driving where set. Not on any in-scope statutory filing.
Work Modality (Telework / On-Site): Colombia ~ Work Modality (Telework / On-Site) ~ Modalidad de trabajo (teletrabajo / presencial) ~ Working modality of the employee. A teleworker earning less than two minimum wages receives the MANDATORY connectivity allowance IN PLACE OF the transport allowance - the two are never paid together. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the employee is a teleworker under Ley 1221 de 2008 as amended by Ley 2466 de 2025 arts. 52-54; defaults to on-site otherwise. ~ Text ~ PRES / TT-AUT / TT-MOV / TT-SUP ~ Work Modality ~ CCG Module 4 (connectivity allowance, Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 53) and Module 2.2. Calculation-driving: selects connectivity allowance vs transport allowance. The nómina electrónica carries a dedicated Teletrabajo devengado element (NIE158); the ALLOWANCE AMOUNT is a parameter/wage type (WTC), not DD.
All-Inclusive Salary Flag: Colombia ~ All-Inclusive Salary Flag ~ Salario integral ~ Indicates that the employee is remunerated under the all-inclusive salary regime of Labour Code art. 132 num. 2, which requires a salary of at least 13 minimum wages AND a written agreement. ~ M ~ Text ~ Boolean true/false on the nómina electrónica XML; S / N (blank or X) on PILA ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ Spec ref: Employee.Integral_Salary_Flag - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE056, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-041, Mandatory=C). HARD RULE: where set, the four PILA contribution-base fields must be 70% of the integral salary. An all-inclusive-salary employee accrues NO separate severance savings, service bonus or severance interest - see the Severance-Savings Regime field.
Non-Salary Pact Flag: Colombia ~ Non-Salary Pact Flag ~ Pacto de exclusión salarial ~ Indicates that an express, written, signed non-salary pact under Labour Code art. 128 attaches to specified payments made to this employee. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where any wage type paid to the employee is treated as non-salary by written pact. The pact must be (a) express, (b) written and (c) attached to identified payments. ~ Text ~ S / N ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ CCG Module 4 (Labour Code art. 128; Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30). Calculation-driving: a valid pact removes the payment from the labour-law salary base permanently, but excludes it from the CONTRIBUTION base only up to 40% of total remuneration - everything above that line is added back. The 40% clamp itself is a parameter and the add-back is a calculated amount (WTC); this flag is the master-data switch that turns the clamp on.
High-Risk Pension Activity Flag: Colombia ~ High-Risk Pension Activity Flag ~ Actividad de alto riesgo para pensión ~ Indicates that the employee performs a high-risk activity under Decreto Ley 2090 de 2003, which carries a non-standard (higher) pension contribution. ~ M ~ Text ~ Boolean true/false on the nómina electrónica XML; S / N (blank or X) on PILA ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ Spec ref: Employee.High_Risk_Pension_Flag - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE043, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-079, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional pair with the PILA pension-contribution-rate field. The RATE is a parameter (WTC), not DD.
Disability / Reinforced Job-Stability St: Colombia ~ Disability / Reinforced Job-Stability Status ~ Situación de discapacidad / estabilidad laboral reforzada ~ Indicates that the employee holds certified disability status. Held because it changes the TERMINATION path - dismissal requires prior Ministry of Labour authorisation under Ley 361 de 1997 - and because Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 15 obliges the employer to report a disability-hiring contract to the Ministry of Labour within 15 days of signature. ~ O ~ Text ~ S / N ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ CCG Modules 2.1 and 9. NOT a contribution or withholding driver in Colombia - Colombia has no disability-percentage tax relief on the payroll side. Held as a compliance-path selector.
Tax Residence Status: Colombia ~ Tax Residence Status ~ Condición de residencia fiscal ~ Whether the employee is a Colombian tax resident under Tax Code art. 10 (more than 183 days of physical presence in any 365-day period, or one of the diplomatic / nationality-plus-connection tests). THE SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL WITHHOLDING SWITCH IN COLOMBIAN PAYROLL. ~ M ~ Text ~ RES / NRES ~ Tax Residence Status ~ Calculation-driving. Resident: the progressive art. 383 table (0/19/28/33/35/37/39%) on the art. 388 depurated base, by Procedure 1 or 2. Non-resident: a FLAT 20% under art. 408 on the GROSS payment, with no depuration, no 25% exempt income, no art. 387 deductions and no tax-free band (DIAN Concepto 011108 of 29 June 2026, upholding Concepto 1789 int. 14595 of 2025). THE SWITCH IS PROSPECTIVE, NEVER RETROACTIVE. INTERNAL CONFLICT TO ESCALATE: CCG Module 2.2 states a non-resident employee is withheld on the same art. 383 table, which contradicts the Module 6.2 matrix and the scope_manifest; Module 6.2 is the authoritative text and is the basis of this field.
Withholding Procedure: Colombia ~ Withholding Procedure ~ Procedimiento de retención en la fuente ~ Employer election, made per employee, between Procedure 1 (Tax Code art. 385 - each month stands alone) and Procedure 2 (art. 386 - a fixed percentage recomputed each June and December from the preceding 12 months). ~ M ~ Text ~ 1 / 2 ~ Withholding Procedure ~ Calculation-driving. CCG Module 6.2: the procedure is elected by the EMPLOYER, per employee, and once elected Procedure 2 binds for the whole six-month semester. The FIXED PERCENTAGE produced by the June/December recalculation is a CALCULATED value (CALC/WTC), not master data. Not available at all for a non-resident, who is withheld at the flat art. 408 rate.
Employee-Requested Withholding Rate: Colombia ~ Employee-Requested Withholding Rate ~ Tarifa de retención solicitada por el trabajador ~ Higher withholding percentage requested in writing by the employee under Tax Code art. 383 par. 3. Employee-declared master data - the employer may not unilaterally increase the Procedure 2 fixed percentage mid-semester, so this is the only lawful route to a higher rate inside a semester. ~ O ~ Decimal ~ Percentage, up to 2 decimals (e.g. 15.00) ~ CCG Module 6.2. This is a USER-INPUT rate, not a statutory parameter: the statutory tables and thresholds remain in the WTC / parameter set. Requires a written employee request on file.
Treaty Status: Colombia ~ Treaty Status ~ País con o sin convenio ~ Whether the non-resident beneficiary is resident in a jurisdiction with a double-tax treaty in force with Colombia. Selects which payment-concept list and which rate basis apply on the monthly withholding return annex. ~ CM ~ Mandatory on every Formulario 350 annex row, i.e. wherever a payment is made to a non-resident. Not applicable to a resident employee. ~ Text ~ CON CONVENIO / SIN CONVENIO ~ Treaty Status ~ Spec ref: Employee.Treaty_Country_Code - CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 141 and casilla 144, Mandatory=C). SIN CONVENIO -> concepto 5 (prestación de servicios y compensación por servicios personales), rate 20% under ET art. 408. CON CONVENIO -> concepto 24 (rentas de trabajo), rate taken from the applicable treaty and possibly lower or nil.
Treaty Country Code: Colombia ~ Treaty Country Code ~ País del convenio ~ Country of residence of the non-resident beneficiary, used on the monthly withholding return annex. ~ CM ~ Mandatory on every Formulario 350 annex row. Where Treaty Status = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force with Colombia. ~ Text ~ ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ~ ISO 3166-1 (see the 'Country Codes - ISO 3166-1' sheet) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Treaty_Country_Code - CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 141 and casilla 144, Mandatory=C). Treaties in force include ES, CL, CH, CA, MX, KR, PT, IN, CZ, GB, FR, IT and JP; Bolivia, Ecuador and Peru are covered by Andean Community Decision 578 rather than a bilateral treaty. The TREATY RATE is a parameter (WTC), not DD - confirm the current list with RA each year.
Art. 380 Non-Filer Declaration: Colombia ~ Art. 380 Non-Filer Declaration ~ Declaración del trabajador - artículo 380 E.T. ~ The employee's own written declaration that the six conditions of Tax Code art. 380 are met, so that the annual certificate of income and withholdings substitutes for the employee's income-tax return. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the employee is not obliged to file an income-tax return and asks that Formulario 220 serve as the substitute. Section 2 of Formulario 220 is completed from the employee's declaration, not from payroll data. ~ Text ~ S / N ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ Spec ref: CO-DIAN-004 Formulario 220 section 2 (ET arts. 378-380). The MONETARY conditions (4,500 UVT gross assets; 1,400 UVT gross income, consumption and deposits) are parameters (WTC); this field records only that the declaration was obtained. Evidence must be retained.
Number of Dependants: Colombia ~ Number of Dependants ~ Número de dependientes económicos ~ Count of economic dependants declared by the employee under Tax Code art. 387 par. 2 and art. 336 num. 3. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the employee claims the dependants deduction; enter 0 if none. Each dependant must also be identified individually - a count alone is not sufficient for the annual information return. ~ Integer ~ 0 to N ~ Calculation-driving family attribute. CCG Module 2.2 and Module 6/7. The DEDUCTION AMOUNTS and caps (10% of gross employment income capped at 32 UVT per month; the additional 72 UVT per dependant per year under art. 336 num. 3, up to four dependants) are parameters and calculated amounts (WTC), NOT DD. Not available to a non-resident.
Dependant Document Type: Colombia ~ Dependant Document Type ~ Tipo de documento del dependiente económico ~ Identity-document type of each declared economic dependant. Repeating block - one occurrence per dependant. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the employee claimed the art. 387 par. 2 dependants deduction during the period. Populated as a bidirectional set with the dependant's document number, name and relationship - all four together or none. ~ Text ~ N(2) - Formulario 220 document-type catalogue ~ Dependant Document Type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Document_Type - CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 79, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-005 (numeral N34, Mandatory=C). The information return requires the dependant's DOCUMENT, not merely a count - a missing document rejects the return. The Form 220 list is NARROWER than the nómina electrónica list.
Dependant Document Number: Colombia ~ Dependant Document Number ~ Número de documento del dependiente económico ~ Identity-document number of each declared economic dependant. ~ CM ~ Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, name and relationship wherever the dependants deduction is claimed. ~ Text ~ Numeric / alphanumeric per the dependant's document type ~ Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Document_Number - CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 80, Mandatory=C).
Dependant Full Name: Colombia ~ Dependant Full Name ~ Apellidos y nombres del dependiente económico ~ Surnames and given names of each declared economic dependant. ~ CM ~ Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, document number and relationship. ~ Text ~ Free text ~ Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Name - CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 81, Mandatory=C).
Dependant Relationship: Colombia ~ Dependant Relationship ~ Parentesco del dependiente económico ~ Relationship of the dependant to the employee and the basis on which dependency is claimed - the two are one question in Colombian law, because each of the five art. 387 par. 2 limbs combines a relationship with a qualifying condition. ~ CM ~ Mandatory together with the dependant's document type, document number and name. The qualifying evidence (education enrolment, medical certification of dependency, absence of income) must be retained. ~ Text ~ Coded value; emitted as free text on Formulario 220 casilla 82 ~ Dependant Relationship ~ Spec ref: Employee.Dependant_Relationship - CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 82, Mandatory=C). Calculation-driving: the five limbs of ET art. 387 par. 2 are exhaustive; a person outside them is not a dependant however genuine the support.
EPS Code: Colombia ~ EPS Code ~ Código de la EPS o EOC del afiliado ~ Institution code of the health insurer (EPS or EOC) the employee has chosen. THE EMPLOYEE CHOOSES; the employer must affiliate to the existing entity, and the choice survives a change of employer. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(6) - contribution-return institution catalogue (administradoras); prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.EPS_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-033, Mandatory=Y). Codes come from the operador's administradoras catalogue, which is an EXTERNAL reference table maintained by the Ministerio de Salud - not enumerated here. CCG Module 2.2: a wrong institution code produces rejected or misdirected contributions.
EPS Transfer Code: Colombia ~ EPS Transfer Code ~ Código de la EPS o EOC a la cual se traslada el afiliado ~ Institution code of the health insurer to which the employee is transferring in the period. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the TAE (traslado a otra EPS) novedad is reported for the period; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with the TAE change event. ~ Text ~ A(6) - administradoras catalogue; prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.EPS_Transfer_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-034, Mandatory=C). Scope option_mapper_scope.benefit_type (TDE / TAE).
AFP Code: Colombia ~ AFP Code ~ Código de la administradora de fondos de pensiones del afiliado ~ Institution code of the pension administrator the employee has chosen - a private individual-account administrator or Colpensiones. THE EMPLOYEE CHOOSES; the choice survives a change of employer. ~ CM ~ Mandatory in general. Blank is permitted ONLY where the Worker Type or Worker Sub-Type is one that is not obliged to contribute to the general pension system - notably Worker Sub-Type 01, an employed old-age pensioner in active service. ~ Text ~ A(6) - administradoras catalogue; prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.AFP_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-031, Mandatory=C). Bidirectional set with Worker Type and Worker Sub-Type.
AFP Transfer Code: Colombia ~ AFP Transfer Code ~ Código de la administradora de pensiones a la cual se traslada el afiliado ~ Institution code of the pension administrator to which the employee is transferring in the period. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the TAP (traslado a otra administradora de pensiones) novedad is reported for the period; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with the TAP change event. ~ Text ~ A(6) - administradoras catalogue; prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.AFP_Transfer_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-032, Mandatory=C). Scope option_mapper_scope.benefit_type (TDP / TAP).
Pension Regime: Colombia ~ Pension Regime ~ Régimen pensional ~ Which of the two Colombian pension regimes the employee belongs to - the public defined-benefit regime (Régimen de Prima Media, administered by Colpensiones) or the private individual-account regime (Régimen de Ahorro Individual con Solidaridad). ~ M ~ Text ~ RPM / RAIS ~ Pension Regime ~ CCG Module 5. Employee election that survives a change of employer and must be declared by a new joiner. Determines which administrator catalogue the AFP code is drawn from and which voluntary-contribution route (art. 55 RAIS voluntary contributions vs additional RPM contributions) is available. The CONTRIBUTION RATES are identical across the two regimes and are parameters (WTC).
CCF Code: Colombia ~ CCF Code ~ Código de la caja de compensación familiar ~ Institution code of the family compensation fund to which the employer is affiliated for this employee. Generally organised by department, so a multi-department employer legitimately carries more than one. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(6) - administradoras catalogue; prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.CCF_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-035, Mandatory=Y). EMPLOYER election (CCG Module 2.1), inherited by the employee, unlike the EPS and AFP which the employee chooses. The 4% levy is NEVER exonerated under ET art. 114-1.
Employee ARL Code: Colombia ~ Employee ARL Code ~ Código de la administradora de riesgos laborales del afiliado ~ Institution code of the occupational-risk insurer covering the employee. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(6) - administradoras catalogue; prefix pattern ^(ARL|EPS|EOC|AFP|CCF|FSP)[0-9]{3}$ - three alphabetic positions naming the subsystem then three numeric positions naming the entity ~ Spec ref: Employee.ARL_Code - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-077, Mandatory=Y). EMPLOYER election, inherited by the employee. Normally equal to the employer ARL code; held per employee because the contribution-return layout carries both.
Severance-Savings Fund Code: Colombia ~ Severance-Savings Fund Code ~ Código del fondo de cesantías del afiliado ~ Code of the severance-savings fund the employee has chosen to receive the annual deposit. THE EMPLOYEE CHOOSES; affiliation is compulsory even where the employer pays severance savings directly under Labour Code art. 57 par. 4. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) - published fund catalogue ~ Severance-Savings Fund ~ Spec ref: Employee.Cesantias_Fund_Code - CO-CESANTIAS-006 (T09, Mandatory=Y). IGNORED where the employer files a single-fund planilla, in which case the planilla-level fund overwrites this value for every record - see the employer field 'Single-Fund Planilla Severance Fund Code'. Any value outside the registered list is REJECTED.
Severance-Savings Regime: Colombia ~ Severance-Savings Regime ~ Régimen de cesantías ~ Which severance-savings regime the employee is under: the Ley 50 de 1990 annual-deposit regime (the default for everyone hired from 1 January 1991), the pre-1991 retroactive regime of the Labour Code, or none because the employee is on an all-inclusive salary. ~ M ~ Text ~ LEY50 / TRADICIONAL / INTEGRAL ~ Severance-Savings Regime ~ Calculation-driving, and a documented reporting trap. Formulario 220 reports the pre-1991 regime at casilla 48 and the amount deposited to the fund at casilla 49, while Formato 2276 reports them in the OPPOSITE order at numerals N19 (fund) and N20 (traditional). MAP BY MEANING, NEVER BY POSITION - see CO-DIAN-004 and CO-DIAN-005 Field Options.
Severance-Savings Deposit Arrangement: Colombia ~ Severance-Savings Deposit Arrangement ~ Modalidad de consignación de cesantías ~ How the employee's severance savings are settled: the ordinary annual deposit to the fund by 14 February, the monthly 8.33% advance deposit permitted by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 64 under a written agreement, or direct payment to the employee discharging the deposit obligation under Labour Code art. 57 par. 4. ~ CM ~ Mandatory for every employee under the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. Where the value is MENSUAL a written agreement must be on file, and the monthly-advance fields of the deposit file are produced; where it is ANUAL only the ordinary annual detail record is produced. ~ Text ~ ANUAL / MENSUAL / DIRECTO / NA ~ Severance-Savings Deposit Arrangement ~ Spec ref: Contract.Cesantias_Regime (CO-CESANTIAS-006 MA01 'Acuerdo escrito para la consignación mensual anticipada', Mandatory=C) - the spec models the monthly-advance gate as a Y/N flag; this DD models the full four-way arrangement and MENSUAL is the value that maps to Y. LATE DEPOSIT COSTS ONE DAY'S SALARY PER DAY OF DELAY, PER EMPLOYEE, UNCAPPED (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3).
Foreign National Not Liable to Pension F: Colombia ~ Foreign National Not Liable to Pension Flag ~ Extranjero no obligado a cotizar a pensiones ~ Indicates that the employee is a foreign national exempt from pension affiliation because affiliation to a pension system abroad has been proved (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.1.2.1.4). ~ CM ~ Where set, the ONLY valid values of Employee Document Type are cédula de extranjería (CE), pasaporte (PA), carné diplomático (CD), salvoconducto (SC) and permiso especial de permanencia (PE). Bidirectional pair with Employee Document Type. ~ Text ~ S / N (emitted as blank or X on the PILA fixed-width file) ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ Spec ref: Employee.Foreign_Not_Pension_Liable_Flag - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-007, Mandatory=C). Calculation-driving: suppresses the pension contribution only. Health, occupational risk and the payroll levies continue to apply. Requires documentary proof on file.
Concurrent Employer (Multi-Employer) Fla: Colombia ~ Concurrent Employer (Multi-Employer) Flag ~ Cotizante con más de un empleador ~ Indicates that the employee holds another concurrent employment. Where there are two or more employers, contributions are made PROPORTIONALLY to each remuneration and accumulate up to the shared 25-minimum-wage ceiling, and the health contribution must be made on the same base. ~ CM ~ Mandatory where the new joiner declares another concurrent employer. The other employer's contribution base must also be captured to apportion the shared ceiling. ~ Text ~ S / N ~ Yes/No Indicator ~ CCG Module 2.2 new-joiner declarations; Ley 100 de 1993 art. 18 par. 1 as substituted by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 5. Calculation-driving switch. The other employer's BASE is a monetary input to the calculation and sits in the WTC / payroll-input set, not in this master-data field. Mis-configuration produces over- or under-contribution against the shared ceiling and is a standing UGPP audit exposure.
Principal Contributor Document Type: Colombia ~ Principal Contributor Document Type ~ Tipo de documento del cotizante principal ~ Identity-document type of the principal contributor to whom a dependent-beneficiary record attaches on the contribution return. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY for a dependent-beneficiary record - typically Worker Type 40, beneficiario UPC adicional. Bidirectional pair with the principal contributor's document number and with Worker Type. ~ Text ~ A(2) - PILA contributor document-type catalogue ~ Employee Document Type (PILA / Cesantias) ~ Spec ref: Employee.Main_Contributor_Doc_Type - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-074, Mandatory=C). Uses the PILA two-letter CONTRIBUTOR catalogue, not the DIAN numeric one and not the EMPLOYER catalogue: the principal contributor is a natural person, so NI is not available here, while RC is (a beneficiary record may attach to a registro civil). Spec T2R2-074 points at the same Sheet 6 table as T2R2-003, 'Tipo documento cotizante'.
Principal Contributor Document Number: Colombia ~ Principal Contributor Document Number ~ Número de identificación del cotizante principal ~ Identity-document number of the principal contributor to whom a dependent-beneficiary record attaches. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY for a dependent-beneficiary record. Bidirectional pair with the principal contributor's document type. ~ Text ~ A(16) left-justified, space-filled ~ Spec ref: Employee.Main_Contributor_Doc_Number - CO-PILA-003 (T2R2-075, Mandatory=C).
Employer Corporate Name: Colombia ~ Employer Corporate Name ~ Razón social del empleador ~ Registered corporate name of the employer. Declarant name on every statutory artefact. ~ CM ~ Populated where the employer is a LEGAL person or a sociedad de hecho. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with the four employer natural-person name fields: a natural-person employer must NOT populate this field. ~ Text ~ A(200) on PILA; variable length on the DIAN artefacts ~ Spec ref: Company.Legal_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE032, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 11, Mandatory=C), CO-PILA-003 (A1-001 and T2R1-004, Mandatory=Y), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 11, Mandatory=C/Y). Bidirectional exclusivity with the natural-person name block, enforced by the instructivo of every artefact.
Employer First Surname: Colombia ~ Employer First Surname ~ Primer apellido del empleador (persona natural) ~ First surname of the employer where the employer is a natural person. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name. ~ Text ~ Variable length ~ Spec ref: Company.First_Surname - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE210, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 7, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 7, Mandatory=C).
Employer Second Surname: Colombia ~ Employer Second Surname ~ Segundo apellido del empleador (persona natural) ~ Second surname of the employer where the employer is a natural person. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name. ~ Text ~ Variable length ~ Spec ref: Company.Second_Surname - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE211, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 8, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 8, Mandatory=C).
Employer First Name: Colombia ~ Employer First Name ~ Primer nombre del empleador (persona natural) ~ First given name of the employer where the employer is a natural person. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name. ~ Text ~ Variable length ~ Spec ref: Company.First_Name - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE212, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 9, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 9, Mandatory=C).
Employer Other Names: Colombia ~ Employer Other Names ~ Otros nombres del empleador (persona natural) ~ Further given names of the employer where the employer is a natural person. ~ CM ~ Populated ONLY where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with Employer Corporate Name. ~ Text ~ Variable length ~ Spec ref: Company.Other_Names - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE213, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-002 (casilla 10, Mandatory=C), CO-DIAN-004 (casilla 10, Mandatory=C).
Employer Person Type: Colombia ~ Employer Person Type ~ Tipo de persona del aportante ~ Whether the employer is a legal person or a natural person. Gates a large conditional block on the contribution return. ~ M ~ Text ~ J / N ~ Employer Person Type ~ Spec ref: Company.Person_Type - CO-PILA-003 (A1-009, Mandatory=Y). Where J: the NIT verification digit and the whole legal-representative block become mandatory. Where N: the valid employer document types narrow to CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, PE and SC - NI is not available - and the verification digit must be ZERO.
Employer Legal Nature: Colombia ~ Employer Legal Nature ~ Naturaleza jurídica del aportante ~ Legal nature of the employer entity. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(1) ~ Employer Legal Nature ~ Spec ref: Company.Legal_Nature - CO-PILA-003 (A1-008, Mandatory=Y). PRIVATE-SECTOR FILTER: the Mercans platform serves private employers, so only value 2 (Privada) is in scope. Public (1), mixed-capital (3), multilateral organisations (4) and foreign public-law entities not subject to Colombian law (5) are excluded - see the mapper Notes.
Class of Contributor: Colombia ~ Class of Contributor ~ Clase de aportante ~ Size and benefit classification of the employer, driven by the number of contributors across ALL branches and by eligibility for the small-business and formalisation regimes. ~ M ~ Text ~ A(1) - A / B / C / D ~ Class of Contributor ~ Spec ref: Company.Aportante_Class - CO-PILA-003 (A1-007, Mandatory=Y). The headcount is counted across all branches and dependencies, NOT per branch. Class D (Ley 1429 de 2010 beneficiary) makes the commercial-registry date and the registered-seat department code mandatory.
Contributor Type: Colombia ~ Contributor Type ~ Tipo de aportante ~ Category of the party making the contribution. For corporate payroll the value is always 1 - Empleador. ~ M ~ Text ~ N(2) zero-filled ~ Contributor Type ~ Spec ref: Company.Aportante_Type - CO-PILA-003 (A1-030 and T2R1-021, Mandatory=Y). PRIVATE-SECTOR FILTER: only value 1 (Empleador) is in scope. Independents (2), public entities and universities (3), guilds and religious congregations (4), associated-work cooperatives (5), diplomatic missions (6) and the remaining special payers (7-12) are excluded - see the mapper Notes.
Form of Presentation: Colombia ~ Form of Presentation ~ Forma de presentación ~ Whether the employer files one consolidated contribution return for the whole legal person or one return per branch. ~ M ~ Text ~ U (único) / S (sucursal) ~ Form of Presentation ~ Spec ref: Company.Presentation_Form - CO-PILA-003 (A1-010 and T2R1-011, Mandatory=Y).
